Process

How a project runs

Four clear steps — you always know what happens next, and you see real work early, never a surprise at the end.

01

Brief & goals

You tell me what you need and what it should achieve. I confirm the scope and show relevant samples before we start.

02

Concepts

You see 2–3 directions early — logo concepts, a thumbnail draft, a website layout or a video's first cut.

03

Revisions

We refine the chosen direction together — colours, wording, timing — checked on a real phone screen.

04

Final files & delivery

Print-ready PDF, PNG/JPG for social media, video in 1080×1920 — every size you need, source files on request.

About

The person behind the work

I'm Shoaib Ahmed — a freelance graphic designer and video editor from Sukkur, Pakistan, and a final-year BSCS student at Sindh Agriculture University, Tandojam (2022–2027).

I help two kinds of clients: creators who need thumbnails and edits that earn clicks, and local businesses that need to look established — a proper logo, matching banners and posts, and a website that actually takes orders.

Everything here is my own work, done end-to-end: the design, the editing, the code behind my two YouTube channels — my edits channel and PySprint, where I teach Python — and two print-ready books published under my own name.

FAQ

Questions before you order

How long does a logo take?

First concepts arrive early — I show directions before polishing anything, so you're never waiting on a surprise. The full timeline depends on the scope and revision rounds, and I confirm it with you before we start.

What files do I get?

Ready-to-use files in every size you need: PNG/JPG for social media, print-ready PDF for print work, and video in vertical 1080×1920 for Reels and Shorts. Source files are available on request.

How many revisions are included?

We refine the chosen concept together until it reads clearly and looks right on a real phone screen. If you'd like a completely new direction after the concept round, we simply treat it as a fresh concept round.

How do I pay?

Local clients can pay by Easypaisa; international clients usually order through my Fiverr profile, which handles payment securely. We agree the method together before any work begins.

Can you match my existing brand style?

Yes — send your current logo, colours, or a page whose look you like, and I'll design inside that system so your logo, banners, posts and website stay consistent.
